title: Swordsman's Letter
wikitext:
The '''Swordsman's Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|1|Swordsman's Letter (quest)|Swordsman's Letter|race=HighElf|class=warrior}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Hail to you, <name>!

I am Valanos Dawnfire, a swordsman of the Thalassian army.

With the fall of Quel’Thalas, my duties now involve protecting what’s left of our land, our heritage, and our people wherever they may reside.

That duty includes training new warriors who can defend our cause.

Seek me out in the lodge, <name>, and I shall hone your inexperienced body into that of a warrior, one that can protect the High Elves!
}}
